clauses.requirement: For ESAs tested in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" (test arrangement per Appendix 3 to Annex 9), shielded supply lines for HV+ and HV- and the three phase lines may be coaxial cables or in a common shield depending on the plug system used; the original HV harness from the vehicle may optionally be used.

For ESAs tested in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" (Appendix 3 to Annex 9), unless otherwise specified, the ESA case shall be connected to the ground plane either directly or via a defined impedance.

For ESAs tested in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" (Appendix 3 to Annex 9), for onboard chargers the AC/DC power lines shall be placed furthest from the antenna (behind the LV and HV harness), with a distance between the AC/DC power lines and the closest harness (LV or HV) of 100 mm (+100/-0 mm).

For ESAs tested in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" (Appendix 3 to Annex 9), unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
Specific test requirements of Annex 9: TEM cell testing shall be carried out in accordance with Appendix 1 to Annex 9.

TEM cell testing (Appendix 1 to Annex 9) shall use the TEM (transverse electromagnetic mode) cell, which generates homogeneous fields between the internal conductor (septum) and the housing (ground plane), as the test method.

TEM cell testing shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3; depending on the ESA tested, the Technical Service shall choose the method of maximum field coupling either to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM cell.
Specific test requirements of Annex 9: bulk current injection testing shall be performed as the applicable test method for the ESA.
